legacy_reference_iso_8859_1.xml.description: A document in ISO-8859-1 without namespaces, signed through the reference of its data by the library as it was before the prefix and the references of the signatures were supported.

legacy_whole_document_utf_8.xml.description: A document in UTF-8 signed as a whole (no reference) by the library as it was before.

legacy_default_namespace.xml.description: A document with a default namespace signed through a reference by the library as it was before.

legacy_package_with_xsi_iso_8859_1.xml.description: An envelope in ISO-8859-1, with the xsi namespace, that has two documents signed alone and is signed over the set of documents, by the library as it was before: three signatures.

legacy_package_without_xsi_utf_8.xml.description: An envelope in UTF-8 without the xsi namespace, with a document signed alone and the signature of the set, by the library as it was before: two signatures.

xmlsec_sha256_prefixed.xml.description: A document signed by xmlsec1 with the prefix ds, SHA256, enveloped and canonicalization transforms, in a document with several namespaces.

xmlsec_whole_document.xml.description: A document signed by xmlsec1 as a whole with the enveloped signature transform.

xmlsec_signed_properties.xml.description: A document signed by xmlsec1 with two references, the second one to properties inside an Object of the signature that are identified by Id (the structure of the signatures of UBL).

xmlsec_compact_document.xml.description: A document with no spaces between its elements, signed by xmlsec1 as it is. The spaces between the elements are part of what is signed, so the signature is only valid while the document keeps them as they are.

xmlsec_package.xml.description: An envelope with two documents signed alone and the signature of the set, all signed by xmlsec1: three signatures.

prefixed_unknown_transform_nested.xml.description: The shape of the books of a tax authority: signatures with the prefix ds, a transform that is not one of XML Signature, and a signed statement inside a signed book, in a document with three namespaces. Xmlsec1 does not support the transform.

prefixed_signed_info_without_namespaces..description: The same shape, with the SignedInfo signed as a fragment that does not declare the namespaces that are in scope, as the signatures that the tax authority accepts. Xmlsec1 rejects them.

incomplete_signature.xml.description: A signature of XML Signature without SignedInfo, as the templates that are completed later: it is a signature that is not valid, not an error.

element_named_signature_that_is_not_a_si.description: An element named Signature that is not an electronic signature (the descriptive one of UBL): the document has no signatures.
